items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: So we came back and Joe Bushkin married Francese the heiress and I think they were married there.

ctx.x: in Brazil long, in fact, I was a little unhappy with it. We were there 14 weeks and actually, although we were on salary all the time, I never did anything, because the Brazilians did a very odd thing. We went into this room where we were a very big success and they decided to close it and decorate it but to pay us. We stayed on and they paid us, until I said, 'I want to do something. I am not going to sit around here and be idle,' so they put me in a show in a big room in the hotel -- I played I Got Rhythm every…
So we came back and Joe Bushkin married Francese the heiress and I think they were married there. She came down to see him.

And Joe came in the other night in this little club I was playing in London and -- in Hampstead -- and he came in and played a couple of -- played for about a half hour with me. I hadn't seen him in a long time and he's playing beautifully. He's here in London with Bing, they open tonight at the Palladium, and Johnny Smith, the great American guitarist is with him too, and Jake Hannah, the drummer with Bing here.
